subject.title: ZNFX1 is a novel mitochondrial dsRNA sensor

verdict_note: Reflects material source-data incompleteness and panel/metadata inconsistencies. Not an allegation of misconduct. Many deposited values reproduce the reported statistics exactly.

gt_provenance.details: Controls are conventional and independently motivated (beta-actin 2^-ddCt, Firefly/Renilla, IgG/input, empty vector, GAPDH/Lamin B1/COX IV loading controls). No circular comparator demonstrated. However raw Ct values, standard curves, FACS event files/gates, ELISA absorbances and blot quantification are absent, so reference stability cannot be independently checked.

score_normalization.details: Many control groups are pinned at exactly 1.000 for every replicate, removing visible control-group variance; testing fold-change rather than underlying dCt can understate uncertainty. Normal for 2^-ddCt reporting and not fraudulent normalization. Absolute ELISA/plaque/FACS values exist for some panels, preventing a blanket FAIL. Raw Ct/dCt and raw Firefly/Renilla readings unavailable.

result_existence.details: Eight independent recomputations reproduced the reported P values exactly (Fig 1f, 1g, 1j, 2a, 2h VSV, 3a, 3c, 7i/7j). Against that: Fig 3f legend claims n=10 but deposited counts never exceed 5 and no event/censoring records exist, so the stated Gehan-Breslow-Wilcoxon P=0.0283 cannot be recomputed; Fig 2h legend says n=3 but H1N1 and HSV-1 carry four values per group and the reported H1N1 P requires all four; Fig 7c legend says wild-type or Mda5-/- while deposited groups are Rig-I-/- and Mda5-/-; Fig 7e and Fig 7g are missing treatment groups; no replicate-level source exists for Fig 4a-e/i, Fig 5b-f or Fig 6j; Extended Data source data promised by the availability statement is absent; the 80% conjunctivitis claim has no animal-level table.

failures.issue: legend n=10 vs deposited survival counts never exceeding 5; no event/censoring records; stated survival P=0.0283 not recomputable
legend n=3 but H1N1 and HSV-1 have four values per group; reported H1N1 P~4.24e-5 requires all four
legend says wild-type or Mda5-/-; deposited groups are Rig-I-/- and Mda5-/-
only EV/uninfected and EV+VSV present; ZNFX1/RIG-I/MDA5 treatment groups missing; means, SDs and P not reproducible
ZNFX1 condition missing; only EV and EV+VSV columns deposited
no replicate-level numerical source data; PDFs provide uncropped images only
failures.evidence: Source Data Fig 4.pdf, Fig 5.pdf, Fig 6.pdf page 1

failures.issue: source data promised by availability statement is absent from the package
80% conjunctivitis claim has no animal-level source table

dead_code.details: No statistical scripts, analysis code, experiment tracker, config files or machine-readable run records exist in the package, so function invocation and DONE status cannot be checked. Potential orphan/unresolvable data: second 'HSV-1 high' row in Fig 2g not distinguishable in panel labels; anomalous Fig 7c value G40=4176.8590572 is ~10x below neighbouring replicates 45515 and 42553 and is not resolvable without raw records.

scope.details: Four cell lines, primary macrophages/PBMCs, mouse cohorts, HIV/SIV observational datasets and several viruses - broader than a single-assay study. But most mechanistic estimates use only n=3 independent experiments, one mouse strain, one main in-vivo RNA-virus challenge, and HSV-1 as the principal DNA-virus comparator. Generalization language ('essential', 'specifically restricts RNA viruses', 'broad anti-RNA-viral spectrum', 'immediately', therapeutic extrapolation) requires qualification. 'Conserved' rests primarily on sequence analysis, not conserved functional tests across species.

eval_type_detail.real_gt: plaque titres, calibrated ELISA concentrations, FACS percentages, animal survival
eval_type_detail.self_supervised_proxy: relative qPCR, reporter ratios, normalized RIP-seq/heatmaps, qualitative blot comparisons
eval_type_detail.human_eval: unblinded conjunctivitis/histopathology interpretation; no blinding performed (manuscript_extracted.txt:3033-3037)
eval_type_detail.simulation_only: promoter/site prediction, phylogenetic and in-silico analyses

action_items: Release raw Ct/dCt values, Firefly and Renilla readings, ELISA absorbances/standard curves, plaque counts, and FCS files with gates.
Correct or explain the Fig 2h n=3 statement versus four deposited replicates.
Supply individual survival times/censoring for all claimed Fig 3f n=10 animals and rerun the stated survival test.
Resolve the Fig 7c WT versus Rig-I-/- label conflict and verify cell G40.
Deposit complete Fig 7e/7g treatment groups and numerical data for Figs 4-6.
Supply the Extended Data statistical source data promised by the availability statement.
Release the Excel/Prism analysis tables or scripts, software settings, multiple-comparison decisions, and an experiment/run ledger.
Analyse qPCR on dCt values; report fold changes for presentation only.
Run a separate blinded pixel-level blot/image forensics pass.

ZNFX1 localizes to mitochondria and interacts with MAVS
ZNFX1 acts immediately as an early sensor
ZNFX1 may provide an early therapeutic strategy

GEO accession retrieval and raw sequencing reanalysis
